title: Key  IPV6_NEXT_HEADER is not supported in MIRRORV6 ACL
author: MaxYaremchuk
body:
**Description**
Key  **IPV6_NEXT_HEADER** is not supported in MIRRORV6 ACL.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Create ACL table by applying json file:
```
{
    "ACL_TABLE": {
        "EVERFLOWV6": {
            "policy_desc": "EVERFLOWV6", 
            "ports": [
                "Ethernet0", 
                "Ethernet4", 
                "Ethernet8", 
                "Ethernet12", 
                "Ethernet16", 
                "Ethernet20", 
                "Ethernet24", 
                "Ethernet28", 
                "Ethernet32", 
                "Ethernet36", 
                "Ethernet40", 
                "Ethernet44", 
                "Ethernet48", 
                "Ethernet52", 
                "Ethernet56", 
                "Ethernet60",
                "Ethernet64"
            ],
            "type": "MIRRORV6",
            "stage": "ingress"
        }
      }
}
```
2. Create a mirror session by applying json file:
```
{
    "MIRROR_SESSION": {
        "session1": {
            "dst_ip": "100.32.0.2", 
            "gre_type": "0x8949", 
            "src_ip": "1.1.1.1", 
            "ttl": "10"
        }
    }
}
```
3. Create ACL rule by applying json file
```
{
    "ACL_RULE": {
        "EVERFLOWV6|RULE_1": {
            "PRIORITY": "9999", 
            "MIRROR_INGRESS_ACTION": "session1",
            "IPV6_NEXT_HEADER": "17",
            "L4_SRC_PORT": "2002",
            "L4_DST_PORT": "2222",
            "SRC_IPv6": "2001::1/64",
            "DST_IPv6": "3000::1/64"
        }
    }
}
```

**Describe the results you received:**
Applying aforementioned rule causes errors: 
```
May 10 15:29:43.693177 auto ERR swss#orchagent: :- doAclRuleTask: Unknown or invalid rule attribute 'IPV6_NEXT_HEADER : 17'
May 10 15:29:43.693177 auto ERR swss#orchagent: :- doAclRuleTask: Failed to create ACL rule. Rule configuration is invalid
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
The key **IPV6_NEXT_HEADER** should be supported for specifying next header following ipv6 header.

comments.author: daall

> @daall any plan to handle this issue?

This has been fixed for mlnx-based SKUs. We can't enable NEXT_HEADER across the board yet b/c it will crash other SKUs. I am working with the other vendors to get it added. The crash mentioned here was fixed by: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/pull/1343

linkedPullRequests.title: [acl] Replace IP_PROTOCOL with NEXT_HEADER for IPv6 ACL tables
linkedPullRequests.author: daall
linkedPullRequests.body:
- Update qualifiers for all platforms
- Fix C++ unit tests
- Add new VS test cases

Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <daall@microsoft.com>

<!--
Please make sure you have read and understood the contribution guildlines:
https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

1. Make sure your commit includes a signature generted with `git commit -s`
2. Make sure your commit title follows the correct format: [component]: description
3. Make sure your commit message contains enough details about the change and related tests
4. Make sure your pull request adds related reviewers, asignees, labels

Please also provide the following information in this pull request:
-->

**What I did**
I updated aclorch to use NEXT_HEADER rather than IP_PROTOCOL for all IPv6 ACL tables.

The 202012 release will still allow users to specify IP_PROTOCOL in config DB, but it will use the new SAI attributes under the hood and print a deprecation warning to the logs.

**Why I did it**
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/4570
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/issues/1316

**How I verified it**
Added new test cases and updated the old VS/C++ unit test cases. Change looks good on physical devices as well.

**Details if related**
